newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan to tender for 30,000T raw sugar on April 22.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan to tender for 30,000T raw sugar on April 22.

text.p: State-owned Taiwan Sugar Corp said on Wednesday it will tender on April 22 in New York city for a 30,000-tonne shipment of raw sugar supply.
The shipment is slated for June 5 to June 20 arrival to Taiwan.
The official said the tender will be an invitation-only tender in New York city on April 22.

Traders said Taiwan Sugar, like most state companies on the rapidly liberalising island, is under mandate to privatise. But the cabinet, in a June 27 ruling, determined it would not face serious competition before 2002.--Taipei Newsroom (5080815)
